notes.title: Twelfth patch!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170693/898f4d2db671d797df1c8a03ebe506ed67a8ae22.png


  Combo reworked. Removed Combo Nova skill sphere upgrade so it no longer reduces the chance of getting a skill upgrade from skill spheres. Added a new skill tree for combo upgrades to library containing both linear upgrades to Combo Nova and Combo Time, and also several different choices of combo effects.
  Added 3 tavern drinks Burning Force, Icy Touch, and Electric Sting.
  Added some new hairstyles and mouth portait pieces.
  Paladins Divine Pillars damage lowered from 200/250/350/450/600 to 200/250/300/350/400
  Paladins Divine Pillars cooldown lowered from 15s to 15s/13.5s/12s/10.5s/9s
  Fixed Paladins Inner Flames damage aura duration.
  Wizard Conjure Hydras cooldown lowered from 6s to 4s.
  Increased the max amount of Hydra heads you can have up by 2.
  Fixed Conjure Hydras visual effects after having upgraded the skill with more hydra heads.
  Fixed Wizard Magic Missile not properly doing damage when bouncing on the same enemy over and over.
  Fixed Berserker Warrior Leap skill getting stuck mid-leap when updating modifiers.
  Rangers bonus to crit from Rhythm stacks now shows up properly in the stats screen.
  Increased radius for trinkets Symbol of Zeal, Symbol of Deflection, Symbol of Rejuvenation, Symbol of Piercing
  Increased library building wood cost slightly.
  Skill Sphere rerolling should no longer be able to get the exact same results in the same order as before.
  Fixed Crossbow Explosive Shot not always properly counting as an attack.
  Fixed Temple entrance to Crypt teleporting the player out of bounds when entering the room after doors have closed.
  Fixed Equipment tooltips where damage based on your attributes would show up lower than it actually was.
  Fixed Enchanter NPC showing up in multiplayer for clients who had already rescued her.
  Fixed an issue where material dropped because something a client did in multiplayer would give nothing if picked up by other players
  Fixed mouse input when using zoomed out UI scale.
  Reduced duplicate enchantment blueprints that you have to find.
  Shady Trader material deals now show how much you get after accounting for material gain stats.
  Trinket picker UI now closes right when you pick something.
  Added prompts to equipment buyer and equipment upgrader town shops when there's nothing to sell/upgrade
  Combo bar in HUD now shows timing.
  Fixed several skill sphere upgrades not properly scaling with spellpower and not properly critting.
  Fixed bug where broken waypoints appear pointing to "You" when switching save profile in town
  Added "Save File Backups" game option to disable saving backups of saves.
  Some cleanups to collision in forest.
  Fixed netsync of taking shared equipment, equipment used to be duped and given to everyone - only relevant for modders and when cheating.
  Fixed revive cheat having to be used twice to work - only relevant for modders and when cheating.
  Added more tags to skill sphere upgrades for:
 
   Paladin: Divine Pillars, Judgement, Armored Knight, Inner Flames
   Ranger: Wolf Companion, Archery, Rain of Arrows, Wind Weaver
   Rogue: Flurry of Blades, Grenade, Artificer Suit
   Warrior: Leap, Ancient Totems, Whirling Axes
   Warlock: Demons Tail
   Wizard: Conjure Hydras, Animated Sword
 

Sorry about it being so long since a patch! We're working on new content which has taken longer than expected due to the feature having grown during development and things like bosses taking quite a lot of effort to get right, but with it being so long we've now separated out some of what we've worked on into this patch so we can get some of these fixes released.

notes.title: Eleventh Patch!
notes.notes:
Added modding support.
 Added sorting to player stash.
 Added options for hiding items in stash.
 Added renaming of save profiles.
 Save profiles are now sorted by when they were last saved to.
 Players with no saves will now default to using steam cloud.
 Improved collision with pits, water, abysses, etc to reduce issues with clipping.
 Fixed several issues with furniture and reward spot placement in Temple, Crypt, Dungeon, and Courts.
 Added toggle to hide lobbies that are much higher level than you from the serverlist, and a message when joining them.
 Fixed bug where equipment could get disabled after level switch if characters base attributes did not cover the requirements.
 Fixed error in renaming characters with special letters in the name.
 Improved focus handling for text input widgets, fixing things like typing 'e' in a name would trigger name randomize.
 Player stats are now properly refreshed when enchanting or upgrading equipment in town.
 Saves now get backups stored in the AppData folder. (%LocalAppData%/HeroesofHammerwatch2/save_backups/)
 Added tooltips to buttons in save profiles picking menu.
 Added more detailed error messages for when failing to join multiplayer lobbies.
 Renamed Attack Power to Weapon Power in Tomes of Power trinket set description.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170693/e12403152800e82c891d2594328cd09e0535e649.png

For more information on making mods, visit our Discord

Note that marking your save as modded cannot be undone and will limit you to only play multiplayer with other modded saves, so if you're unsure you might want to make a copy of your save first.

notes.title: Tenth Patch!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170693/c42a36b2cee153c8f1d48898430179ece2267d2c.png
Shadow Curse

 Regular enemies no longer cause curse with their attacks, attacks from shades will still cause curse.
 Added cursed floor traps to Crypt, Dungeon, Barracks and Courts trap rooms in New Game+.
 Added Cursed Chests and Resource Caches when playing in New Game+, these spawn both rewards and shades.
 Reduced the amount of shades in citadel shortcut.
 Increased shades HP and Armor.
 Cultists no longer summon shades.
 Changed the Shadow Curse Gain stat to be multiplicative instead of additive.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170693/24f615de5733b35d63d41ff66cd64f61ba295890.png

 Added Elixirs that give permanent attribute increases. Every NG+ reached unlocks 3 elixirs to be found for each of the 5 attributes (str/dex/int/foc/vit). These Elixirs can be found in cursed chests and caches, and are awarded for killing the final boss, however you need to be playing a high enough NG+. To find the first 3 elixirs you need to be playing NG1 or higher, for the next 3 you must be in NG2 or higher, etc.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170693/7ff0a2b66deb5660502d7debd00d6b9be16f0528.png

 Added rerolling of skill spheres and trinket pickers. When reaching New Game+ you will receive an accomplishment that awards a reroll charge, these can be used at skill spheres and trinket pickers in order to get new choices, at the cost of some curse.


Courts

 Updated Courts theme lighting, generation and some visuals.
 Reworked Courts trap rooms to use cursed floor traps as well as beam traps.
 Added braziers to Courts in New Game+ for purging curse.
 Courts archer no longer shoots triple arrows when you're nearby in melee range.



 Added Symbol of Zeal, Symbol of Deflection, Symbol of Rejuvenation and Symbol of Piercing trinkets in a set - Symbols of Fate.
 Changed Blackjack, Throwing Stars and Kyras Quiver to deal a percentage of Main Hand Weapon damage instead of fixed values in order to scale better with your character.
 Parry Medal trinket now also triggers a riposte when parrying which returns 200% Main Hand Weapon damage.
 Changed final 5-piece bonus of Soldiers Uniform trinket set to give Life Leech on Weapon Crit.
 Added Shield Mastery to weapon mastery trainer for increasing block amount on shields.
 Life leech now heals at double the rate, but the pool of life leeched is now reset when reaching full health, so you can no longer overheal and "store" it.
 Enemy groups no longer spawn with multiple different bannermen. This should lead to roughly the same amount of enemies buffed by a banner, but much fewer being buffed by multiple different banners.
 Fix for healing banners healing faster in multiplayer.
 Made the Troll Ruler enemy in Dark Caves more common.
 Dark Halls skull "mines" no longer spawn so they overlap.
 Updated Accomplishment tooltips in the Guild Halls menu to be a bit more clear.
 Improved collision with bottomless pits in Dark Halls so it's less common to be pushed into them.
 Fixed issue with players who have very high damage reduction sometimes getting wrongfully hit with massive damage numbers.
 Fixed Hand Crossbow not always properly applying armor penetration.


This patch changes curse from a combat mechanic to a risk/reward mechanic, and because cursed chests can contain an extra cursed trinket the potential rewards of doing a curse run should be higher. The addition of Elixirs should help with long term scaling of equipment requirement which can feel a bit too steep when you get higher in levels, Elixers being found mostly in Cursed Resource Caches along with crystals and dust gives a nice reward for taking on a fight with some shades.

notes.title: Ninth patch
notes.notes:
* Fixed Spell Mastery taking more skill points than it should
* Fixed issue of donating immediately when opening chapel donation window when using gamepads
* Lowered Courts undead archer damage
* Made bannerman/banner protection aura weaker
* Lowered armor, resistances and health of banners and bannermen
* Added marker effects to banners and bannermen to improve visibility
* Fixed protection banner healing enemies
* Fixed Warrior Tyrant Chains damage not properly scaling with skill leveling
* Fixed Elemental Orb duration not properly scaling with skill upgrade
* Fixed Incanter's Cadence - Incanter's Flow skill description
* Fixed rarely incorrectly placed projectile shooters in crypt
* Fixed a trap room in Courts never appearing
* Fixed blacksmith not being able to upgrade items when player has a full inventory

This is just a small patch with fixes, the next larger patch will be a rework of how you get curse intended to change it to more of a risk/reward mechanic rather than a combat mechanic.

notes.title: Eighth Patch!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170693/a4bb64c2b4c23cb855a6a6ed704a40dc139e5185.png

 Donating resources to the Chapel now gives town-wide permanent buffs like the class titles, these can be seen in the Titles menu and donation is done both by dying in a mission and through donating resources directly at the Tier 5 Chapel
 Added Spell Mastery mechanic unlocked by finding a new NPC in Dungeons in New Game+ 1
 Each point of Strength now gives Armor Penetration
 Dexterity and Intelligence crit damage scaling changed from linear to decaying growth, below 400 DEX/INT this is a buff, but beyond that they start to fall off
 Holding down a button in the attribute assigner and material trader UIs now repeat the press to minimize annoying repeat clicking
 Material trader UI now lets you change how much to trade at a time
 Mission loadout NG+ picking now rolls around, so doing NGP- at 0 picks the highest
 Fixed Girdle of Might attunement being broken
 Fix for Barracks trap room that can break level layout
 Fixed enchanting menu for "broken" enchanted items (of Insightfulness)
 Fixed being able to buy the same enchant multiple times wasting resources
 Chests no longer only give primary stat equipment and instead bases it on what you've picked for attributes
 Fix for warriors Killing Spree - Dauntless being broken
 Fixed prospectors pride drink
 Summons now respawn faster on level switch
 Disabled multiplayer dropin in avatar boss fight and citadel shortcut
 Lowered enchant cost scaling so its a bit cheaper at high levels
 Increased dust/crystal NG+ scaling from +10% to +20%
 Trinkets, debuffs (like bleed), etc now scale with spell power
 Fixed issue where the Mysterious Citadel achievement would not be awarded if you already found the architect forcing you to start a new save to get it
 Added spell tags to Wolf Companion, Summon Fiends, Gargoyle Servant, Conjure Hydras, Animated Sword, Demon's Tail, and Soul Vortex


Armor
Armor and resistance has been reworked a bit in order to increase the difference between having high and low armor/res, in general this is a buff to armor/res bonuses and a buff to the armor/res penetration mechanics.

 Negative armor and resistance is no longer half as "powerful" as positive armor (it used to be that negative 100 armor only gave half the debuff as positive 100 armor gave as a buff)
 Armor and resistance penalties from New Game+ now lowered to -120 and -65 to match negative armor efficiency change
 Armor and resistance penetration remade to be percentage based instead of just a constant offset, penetration can no longer push armor below 0
 Adjusted enemy and boss armor/resistance values and scaling to match changes in armor and resistance
 Lowered curse armor/resistance penalty from 4 + 1*NG+ to 3 + 0.66*NG+


Enemies

 Introducing new Bannermen enemies to Dark Citadel in New Game+
 Ranger enemies in Dark Citadel now scale up their attacks in New Game+
 Made Avatar phase 3 deal slightly less damage and phase 1 slightly more
 Lowered damage for crossbowmen in Barracks
 Increased damage for archers in Courts
 Slightly increased how fast lightning wizards in Courts build up their damage


Weapons

 All weapons above tier 1 now also do damage based on character attributes, so for example swords now do a bit more damage depending on your Strength
 Weapon masteries increased to 5% bonus damage per point instead of 3%
 Dexterity bows secondary attack changed from Power Shot to Arrow Volley
 Strength bow Power Shot now shoots 3 arrows instead of 1 and goes a little bit longer
 Added 10% armor penetration to crossbow bolts
 Increased Crossbow - Explosive Shot explosion size a little


Wizard

 Barrier - Frost Shell armor bonus lowered from 25%/50%/100% to 20%/40%/60%
 Lowered Incanters Flow mana cost reduction and cast speed increase from 2%/3%/4%/5%/6% to 2%/2.5%/3%/3.5%/4%
 Enhanced Physique no longer gives Intelligence


Ranger

 Fixed bug where Entangle - Healing Wisps and Entangle - Poison Ivy weren't mutually exclusive
 Lowered Wind Weaver cooldown from .25s to .15s
 Increased Wolf Companion attack speed
 Sped up Rain of Arrows a little
 Lowered Archery - Fast Shot skill speed bonus from 10%/20%/40% to 10%/20%/30%


Paladin

 Lawbringer - Punish the Wicked no longer does a damage increase against silenced/disarmed enemies and instead drop Judgement hammers on them
 Changed paladins Inner Flames - Flames of Devotion to add damage per character level instead of flat damage
 Lowered paladins Inner Flames max amount of stacks from 7 to 5


Sorcerer

 Ice Mastery - Ice Block now shoots 3 shards of Ice Nova when blocking an attack

notes.title: Seventh patch!
notes.notes:
Trinket material rewards (Crystal and Dust) after a mission now go up by 10% per New Game+
 Fixed issue with resuming runs spawning the player out of bounds from the level
 Fixed broken healing on Entangle and Dark Ritual for clients in multiplayer
 Added some more high tiers of certain accomplishments: Damagers, Heavy Hitters, Critical Hitters, Potion Gulpers, Spellcasters, Blockers, Combo Streakers, Hunter, Murderer, Exorcist, Demolisher, Sanctifier
 Adjusted high tiers of accomplishments so Murderer and Demolisher are a bit quicker to get and Exorcist a bit slower to get, to make them more even
 Shadow Rifts minimap icon now shows when it's been used
 Character screen now defaults to equipment inventory when opened in town
 Fix for Apothecary removing potion charge upgrades when talking to her in intro mission with a higher level character in multiplayer
 Icon/keyword legend in bottom left of UI now shows keyword descriptions for equipment
 Fixed lesser shades showing hp bars while in spawn animation
 Blueprints in levels are now a bit more consistent in how often they show up
 Added info about current ilvl to blacksmith equipment upgrading
 Fixed issue with getting Builders accomplishment incorrectly as client in multiplayer
 Fixed Conviction - Shield of Faith level up bonus of block amount being reversed
 More string and UI adjustments for game translatability in different languages, "unicode" font now works better for non-chinese languages, "chinese" font-set added for previous behavior if preferred


We've been working on a number of balance changes with a focus on improving the scaling of certain mechanics, especially weapon attacks and strength builds. It's not quite ready yet, but it will be the focus of the next patch.

notes.title: Sixth Patch!
notes.notes:
Added character customization to the Guild Hall
 Minimap now shows when some more dungeon features (Traveling Cook, Shady Trader, Trinket Shop, Imp, etc) have been used
 Changed minimap icons of valuables, materials and equipment
 Serverlist now displays some information about level of characters in a lobby
 Added game option Multiplayer Game Marker to be able to turn off and change the color of the markers below other players
 Added 2 hair colors and some more feminine jaw shapes
 Fixed AoE player skills being inconsistent in dealing damage as a client in multiplayer (Entangle, Firewall, Glyphs, etc)
 Fixed Masonry Chisel trinket and Apothecary's Supplies trinket set descriptions
 Fixed Wicked Hooks trinket breaking when attuned
 Lowered Rogue's Grenade mana cost to match description
 Fixed Whirlwind & Flamespray dealing inconsistent damage
 Fixed issue where a player wouldn't get a NG+ increase if the mission played was higher than his max
 Fixed shadow curse removal stat not counting curse removed by Imp
 Fixed Magic Shop mission loadout displaying as empty even though it had something selected
 Removed indestructible firewood stack from high level town square prefabs
 Added player classes to Coop HUD
 Fixed level announce text not properly being centered on some boss levels
 Fixed issue where free skillpoints didnt show in playermenu when there were no free attribute points
 Combo: None now shows as picked at Library
 Fixed some more strings not being changeable by translations
 Class promotion UI can now be closed by X in corner


At the magic mirror in the Guild Hall you can now change the name and look of your character for a small fee.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170693/fb9b0625fbddab7543a9a614a73246df9e121fb0.png

notes.title: Fifth patch!
notes.notes:
Added workshop support for game translations
 Boss equipment rewards can now include 2-handed and off-hand weapons
 Added ability to turn off combo at library
 Equipment ilvl you find in runs is now capped to the highest value of 5 levels above your level cap and 10 levels above your current level
 Adjusted Imp gold and material rewards to give more early in the game but scale up slower
 Increased Orb of Restoration trinket +Mana Regen from 5 to 10
 Lowered Drums of Battle trinket cooldown from 8s to 2s, so the effect can now be refreshed, but not stacked
 Toned down Elemental Prism visual effect
 Fixed NPC pathfinding in town
 Changing class specialization now clears assigned skills from previous picked one
 Fixed Wizards Animated Sword - Flame Blade losing its damage
 Fixed Warlock limit to Chaos Rifts being broken for clients
 Fixed breaking saves when switching save profile while in a run
 Fixed buffs and summons not clearing when swapping character and class specializations in town


For help with game translations, take a look in the steam forum thread below,
https://steamcommunity.com/app/619820/discussions/0/604146344638072533/

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed small error with equipment scaling introduced in last patch
 Fixed Dark Halls being completely dark when resuming a run in it

notes.title: Fourth patch!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, this patch is mostly focused on fixing issues rather than balance adjustments. Along with the fixes below we've also made an adjustment on the final boss so he should always be able to get back to the arena rather than getting stuck. Thanks to everyone who's been reporting issues, we're doing our best to fix as many issues as we can as quickly as we can. 


 Fixed an issue with clicking a lobby in the server list but joining a different one
 Fixed a bug with blueprints that cannot be picked up
 You can no longer evade your own or other players' attacks
 Fixed attacks like Whirlwind (2h Axe) and Flame Spray (Fire Staff) being broken at certain attack speeds
 Fixed Rabbit's Foot trinket not gaining effect when attuned
 Fixed flame floor traps being inconsistent in their timing when turning on and off
 Fixed not seeing the level when multiplayer spectating in Dark Halls
 Fixed visual glitch when dashing into walls in Dark Halls
 Fixed an issue of some buffs showing with no names stat tooltips
 Fixed skill icons missing in player menu
 Fixed Rogues Fan of Knives showing incorrect mana costs in its description
 Added mark for trinkets being attuned on their icons in the inventory
 Pyre town building now increases how many curses braziers remove
 Lowered enemy damage scaling from multiplayer player count
 Doubled how quickly Elemental Prism shoots
 Doubled Arctic Step damage and how many ice patches are spawned
 Increased Scroll of Hellfire meteors spawn rate by 66% and cut the fall time by 66%, also slightly increased meteor spread and AoE

notes.title: Third patch!
notes.notes:
Added Save Profiles menu with support for Steam Cloud and having separate saves
 Added game option for managing visibility and colors on different kinds of health bars, letting you visually distinguish between player, enemy, allied players and minion health bars
 Fixed Weapon Mastery attunement being inconsistent and sometimes broken
 Fixed Evasion being broken
 Added a graphic to the load screen with a game option to change its brightness
 Fixed trinket picker not showing attuned trinket descriptions
 Added separate icons to Monolith buffs
 Improved wording in a few different tooltips and descriptions
 Fixed trap room in Dungeon missing a reward
 Added HUD icon for Warriors Rage buff
 Fixed Rangers Entangle showing incorrect mana costs in its description


Balancing:

 Reduced trap damage scaling
 Added Architect effect Gentle Traps which lowers trap damage taken by 50%
 Changed Rogue class title from gold gain to reduced trap damage
 Buffed Ranger and Wizard class titles to give 3 instead of 2 of attack/spell power
 Life leech now heals over time with a maximum of filling your health to max over 5 seconds
 Improvements to player minions targeting and movement
 Slight adjustment to enchanting costs
 Imp reward when upgrading item levels now upgrades 5 levels with a max of +15 total on the item going beyond the blacksmiths total of +10
 Lightning attack from wizards in Courts now have slightly higher damage but it builds up over time giving you a chance to move away
 Avatar boss in New Game+ 5 and above now does some more damage with the slam in phase 3
 Two-handed maul damage increased from 150% to 175% weapon damage and Ground Slam increased from 200% to 250% weapon damage
 Charged shot with bows now penetrate up to 6 enemies instead of 4
 Bows now shoot 33% faster with a reduced movement speed penalty while attacking
 Dexterity bows no longer shoot slower while moving


New Game+:

 Experience rewards from enemies now go up by 33% every New Game+
 Enemies base armor and resistance now go up by 33% every New Game+
 Minor adjustment made to enemies base armor and resistance to increase slowly and progressively for every New Game+
 Enemies now do 5% more base damage per New Game+
 Lowered armor of the big eye enemies in Dark Halls in New Game+


Sorcerer:

 Lowered Frost Nova damage from 50/70/100/130/170 to 50/70/90/110/130 but increased their travel distance by 40%
 Increased Frost Nova - Frost Seekers trigger chance from 25%/50% to 33%/66%
 Lowered Discharge chaining from 2/4 to 2/3 and increased bounce dmg reduction from -10% to -20%
 Lowered Flame Wall cooldown from 15s to 13s

Ranger:

 Lowered ranger wind weaver cooldown from 0.5s to 0.25s
 Ranger wolf attack AoE increased in size

Wizard:

 Changed Magic Missiles damage from 40/50/70/90/130 to 50/60/70/85/100

Warlock:

 Fixed Drain Essence scaling but lowered it from 2%/3%/5%/7%/10% to 2%/2.5%/3%/3.5%/4%
 Lowered Drain Essence - Life Siphon restoration from 2%/3%/4% to 2%/2.5%/3%
 Lowered Chaos Blade damage from 100/120/160/200/260 to 100/120/140/160/180
 Lowered Chaos Rifts max amount from 4/4/6/6/8 to 4/4/5/5/6
 Lowered Blood Ritual - Leeching Ritual life leech 5%/7.5%/10% to 2%/3%/4%



Some builds have been overperforming significantly while others are underperforming, so while we are toning down some subclasses to keep progression challenging we are also improving others in order to try to increase the variety in viable builds.
We are open to hear additional feedback from the community and although we have been quite overwhelmed with the response, we are reading and listening to what you are saying and we are trying to improve the game to make it the best it can be and enjoyable to everyone.



For people who want to move their existing save to Steam Cloud, the process is to go in to the new Save Profiles menu, copy your current profile, select Steam Cloud as the location of your new profile, and finally switch to it.

notes.title: Second patch!
notes.notes:
* Added player level to multiplayer HUD element
* Added sound option for disabling the combo sound loop
* Added game option for multiplayer names opacity
* Added missing combo descriptions to library menu
* Picking combo at the Library now awards the appropriate achievement if it wasn't gained already
* Fixed a bug where a mission selection made in multiplayer could stick in your singleplayer town
* Fixed a couple of exploits related to resuming a run
* Fixed a bug where you could resume a run and spawn in the previous level with several things broken
* Fixed a bug where a client in multiplayer could build buildings based on what the host had unlocked
* Fixed a bug where a client in multiplayer could create a character based on what classes the host had unlocked
* Fixed a bug where clients could sometimes take a trinket on the ground meant for the host
* Thunderbird no longer does damage to players when spawning in
* Added confirm prompts for exiting game and abandoning a run
* Fixed issue with players getting stuck behind the gate of the Shadow Face boss fight
* Fixed several minor issues in the Courts act

We don't quite have a proper roadmap with new features we're planning on adding yet, we're looking at feedback and prioritizing things based on that. Right now our high priority large issues are multiplayer connectivity problems, adding in save profiles with steam cloud support, modding support starting with translations, and some kind of redesign of the curse system in New Game+ to let it be a bit more of a risk/reward decision for the player rather than having it just be a part of enemy attacks.

notes.title: First patch!
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for playing the game and reporting issues, we're reading your feedback and looking at the bugs. We're looking at fixing the more serious bugs as soon as possible but wanted to get a patch out quickly to address some of the simpler things people have mentioned.

* Added graphical option for diabling wind animations on foliage
* Added game option for UI scale
* Added game option for toggling to a larger crosshair
* Fixed kill elites accomplishment tracking
* Tab overlay text now shows New Game+ level
* Accomplishment tooltip now correctly shows the currently awarded stuff
* Server list now shows the NG+ and region the game is currently in
* Fixed some overlapping text issues on pick character screen
* Fixed empty effects showing up in Effects tab in Player Menu
* Fixed icons on Closed Circuit trinket and Palains Inner Flames skill
* Fixed Paladins Lay on Hands reducing in size when getting Cleaning Touch
* Added Rings of Resistance trinket set
* Lowered mana leech from Soul Anguish tavern drink
* Reduced cooldown on Wizards Haste and Meteor Shower, Sorcerers Firewall, Rogues Poison Cloud, and Paladins Judgement skills
* Increased cooldown on Warriors Totem skill
* Added evasion to Cult Assassins and Skeleton Crawlers in NG+
* Lowered requirement for the highest tier of the combo accomplishment

We've also applied a tentative fix for town progress being lost on rare occasions when hosting in multiplayer. This will at least help us identify the issue.

notes.title: Heroes of Hammerwatch 2 release date
notes.notes:
Starting the year off with some exciting news, 
Heroes of Hammerwatch 2 will be released on January 14th!  

Can't wait for everyone to be able to experience the game in full, 
make sure you add it to your wishlist to get a reminder when it is released. 

also, its been asked a lot, so for confirmation
Demo saves/progress will not carry over to the full game.

Happy New Year from everyone at Crackshell! 🎉

notes.title: Heroes of Hammerwatch II Demo update
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for trying our demo and giving feedback on the forums and on Discord! We're going to keep the demo online for a while longer, and we've just updated it with some improvements and additions.

* Added tooltips to stats in the player screen for a breakdown of where you get your stat from.
* Added a thunderbird that can bring your materials back to town.
* Added indicator in HUD for when you have dash charges.
* Reworked health and mana pickups to be a bit more obvious.
* Added spell power upgrades to Magic Shop.
* Several smaller fixes in shop UIs.
* Changed dirk from an offhand to a mainhand weapon that is now int-based and deals physical and poison damage.
* Improved behavior when switching to fullscreen.
* Game should no longer crash on startup on certain Core i7 CPUs.
* Paladin Conviction: Tweaked and reworked all upgrades.
* Paladin Blessed Strike: Reworked lightning upgrade to be more consistent and impactful.
* Paladin Armored Knight: Wrath upgrade now deals damage based on your Armor.
* Paladin Inner Flames: Stack duration now resets when casting a spell.
* Wizard Arcane Intellect: Reworked base skill and some upgrades.
* Wizard Fireball: The projectile now deals collision damage and loses speed when colliding with enemies.

notes.title: Heroes of Hammerwatch II Demo update
notes.notes:
Just a small one, trying to clear up some of the quicker issues.

* Gave the small material icons more detail.
* Fix for minimap opacity.
* Fix for missing tooltips.
* Some UI fixes.
* Another multiplayer fix.

notes.title: Heroes of Hammerwatch II Demo update
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for trying the demo and reporting issues!

* Added options for a minimap in the top corner
* Updated UI for the player stash.
* Fixed some issues with tooltips not closing with shops.
* Possible fix for broken levels in the temple act, where you can't reach the exit.
* Possible fix for certain multiplayer timeouts.
* Made NPCs in town a little less "loud"
